card.name: Asking the reader what they think
card.fires_on: The word 'think' (or 'about', 'you', 'this') in direct questions or prompts that address the reader, such as 'What do you think?' or 'think about how...'. Mostly general web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Opinion questions
modes.description: 'think' or 'you' at the end of a question asking the reader's view.
modes.example: “I’m not sure how I feel about that,” I say honestly. “What do you<< think>>?” This week my kids are working

modes.label: Think about / thought about
modes.description: 'about' or 'thought' after a verb of thinking, inviting reflection.
modes.example: Ever thought<< about>> what that term really means?

modes.label: Reader-directed page text
modes.description: 'this' or 'you' in instructions or prompts to the reader on a web page.
